name: zeypm
description: Conventions and automation for keeping a zeypm-tracked project current: the zeypm-tracking skill, a configurable Stop reminder, session-start tracking context, and an opt-in live feed that mirrors your sessions on zeypm's Agents screen (answer the agent's questions from there). Pair it with your project's zeypm MCP connection.

stop_reminder_mode.title: Stop reminder mode
stop_reminder_mode.description: What happens when a session changes code without a tracker update: 'nudge' (default — a gentle, non-blocking message), 'block' (the turn only ends after a tracker write), or 'off'.

inject_context.title: Inject session context
inject_context.description: Inject the zeypm tracking summary (and the project's .claude/zeypm-conventions.md, when present) at session start. Disable if you carry these in your own CLAUDE.md.

offer_seeding.title: Offer tracker seeding
offer_seeding.description: Allow the skill to offer seeding a tracker structure (milestone lists, tags, relations) when a project's tracker is empty and a written plan exists. Disable if you never want that proposed.

live_feed.title: Live session feed
live_feed.description: Mirror this machine's Claude Code sessions on your zeypm Agents screen (needs a feed token from Settings → Agents, set up with /zeypm:feed). Nothing is sent until a project is mapped; file contents and command output never leave the machine.

answer_hold_minutes.title: Answer hold (minutes)
answer_hold_minutes.description: When the agent asks a question and you have had a zeypm tab open in the last two minutes, how long the CLI waits for your answer from the screen before asking in the terminal instead. At most 10.

send_message_text.title: Send prompt and reply text
send_message_text.description: Include your prompts and the agent's end-of-turn replies (capped at 4096 characters) in the live feed. Off sends only the task keys found in them.
